messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up — AcmeHealth POC moving to finance. They want an order form + PO, and legal asked for an MSA redline. Key asks: KMS/HSM clause, data residency, and net45 payment. Attaching draft orderform `orderform_v1.pdf`. any volunteers for review? @maria_legal @devon_ps
maria_legal: I'll take the initial pass. Need to confirm KMS language — do we support customer-managed keys for hosted? Also need to clarify breach notification SLA (72h?)
devon_ps: On the tech side: customer wants private deployment option (VPC) for POC, and SOC2 report. We can offer dedicated for POC but might need a price add. What's expected qps/throughput?
alex_sales: They estimated 2-3 QPS sustained, occasional spikes to 8. Pricing ask: can we keep POC at USD 2k/month credit? They also want invoice billed to parent company with PO #45678.
priya_eng: For VPC we need ~2 weeks to provision + infra ticket. If they need HSM integration for KMS, that'll add time. Recommend temp workaround: dedicated pool + customer IP allowlist.
maria_legal: Redlines: counterparty indemnity needs tightening, and we'd accept 72h notification. Also need to confirm subprocessor list and DPA addendum. I'll upload redline as a DocuSign-friendly PDF.
alex_sales: FYI procurement wants signature via DocuSign to vendor@acmehealth.com. Can we route to multiple signers? They need exec signature + billing contact.
contracts-bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelope_id=env-2026-17345; awaiting signer mapping. :eyes:
erin_finance: For PO, finance can accept net45 but need scanned PO matched to invoice. Send accounting@redwood.com cc on final doc.
devon_ps: Quick config suggestion — include a 'fallback model' clause in orderform to allow lower-cost variant if capacity constrained. Preserves SLOs. I'll draft a one-liner.
maria_legal: +1 to fallback clause. Also carve out telemetry for quality monitoring; confirm data is hashed/pseudonymized in logs.
alex_sales: Next steps: Maria to upload redline by EOD, Devon to add fallback line, Priya to open infra ticket. I'll coordinate with procurement and update customer. :thumbsup:
priya_eng: infra ticket INF-924 created. ETA: 10 business days for VPC; HSM integration TBD.
